message.text:
🚀 IMPLEMENT SWEDEN IS GROWING – Join Us! 🚀
Are you a student or soon-to-be graduate with a passion for management consulting? We're looking for new talents to join our Swedish team!
💡 Who we're looking for:
🔹 Students graduating in Summer 2026
🔹 Those ready to tackle exciting challenges in a dynamic network-based environment
 
Curious to learn more? Meet us at our student event this September 🤝
📌 Links to job openings and student event can be found in the comments below.

We’re excited to see your application and hopefully welcome you to our team! 🌟

Link to open jobs in graduate positions: https://implementconsultinggroup.com/implement-sweden#job-openings-sweden

Link to student event: https://implementconsultinggroup.com/events/explore-your-future-at-implement
